generated_by: visualizer/scripts/export_hull_mounts.mjs (do not edit; regenerate after any hull-kit or fleet_ships.json change)
frame: x forward, y port, z dorsal; metres from the hull centre; angles in degrees
viewer_frame: body (x, y, z) = hull-kit (Z nose, X port, Y dorsal) * metres_per_scene_unit; azimuth = atan2(y, x), elevation = asin(z)

grid.order: row-major by elevation cell from -90 up, then azimuth cell from -180 up
grid.cell: az_cell = floor((az + 180) / 5) mod 72, el_cell = clamp(floor((el + 90) / 5), 0, 35); k = el_cell * 72 + az_cell
grid.bits: cell k is bit (7 - k % 8) of byte k // 8 of bytes.fromhex(blocked) (MSB first), 648 hex digits; 1 = blocked

notes.mounts: listed in data/fleet_ships.json weapons order; the per-frame `tur` trace field uses this order
notes.pos: pivot: gun = yaw axis at trunnion height, pd = ball centre, spinal = muzzle, launcher = magazine bank centre
notes.axis: mount normal (the yaw axis; elevation of a turret is measured from the plane normal to it); spinal: boresight
notes.rounds: launcher only: each magazine round in firing order (the k-th launch from the tube is round k): pos = round centre (m), eject = unit direction it leaves its rail / cell (rack: outboard, square to the hull axis; cell: out of the hatch), nose = its nose at rest (unit)
notes.blocked: own static geometry sampled at cell centre + corners and grown by one cell, OR outside the mechanical limits (turret depression below min_elevation_deg under the mount plane; spinal outside gimbal_deg of the nose); launchers are all-open
notes.open_fraction: solid-angle weighted share of the sphere left open
notes.self_blocked_fraction: share of the mechanically reachable directions lost to the ship's own geometry (incl. margin)
